call_purpose: You wanted your webinar registration page to send the confirmation email and your products page to stop showing the wrong currency.

resolved.text: We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar registration page, which had been turned off, and saved it.
Following our guidance, you registered once with your other email to test it, and you confirmed the confirmation email arrived.
Following our guidance, you selected Indian Rupee in Settings, Regional and saved it, and your products page now shows rupees, which you also confirmed.

covered.text: We explained that the currency is set in your account's regional settings and that only the account owner can change it.
